decisionsTitle: An invitation goes onto the hidden list only while the event's «Folosește lista ascunsă» is on
decisionsSection:
**The batch review of 2026-10-03.** Two features met in one batch: invitations by email, whose send carries «Pe lista ascunsă (nu ocupă un loc)» (`event_invitations.outside_capacity`), and the hidden list's event switch «Folosește lista ascunsă» (`events.hidden_list_enabled`, migration `0126`, off by default), under which the registration page's radio refuses to put anybody on the list with `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`. The invitations' tick did not ask the switch: an Administrator could invite people onto the hidden list of an event whose hidden list is off, and the registration the link created landed on it — the one thing the registration page would have refused.

**Decision.** `inviteToEventByStaff` refuses `outsideCapacity: true` while the locked event row's `hiddenListEnabled` is false, with the same `DomainError` (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, marker `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`) the radio throws — read under the event lock, so a save switching the list off and a send racing it cannot both win, and refused after the event's own checks but before any person is read, any row written or any email queued. `inviteAction` turns the marker into the registration page's sentence, `Admin.errors.HIDDEN_LIST_OFF` («Lista ascunsă e oprită la acest eveniment. Bifează întâi «Folosește lista ascunsă» în setările evenimentului.»), handed back with the server's forecast like every other refused send. `InvitationsPanel` reads the event's switch and `InviteForm` draws the tick only while it is on; the refusal is what a page drawn before the switch went off meets.

**What stays.** An invitation already sent «Pe lista ascunsă» while the switch was on keeps its mark and its link seats the registration outside the places even if the switch is turned off later — as switching the list off takes nobody already on it off (the hidden list's own decision); «Retrimite» and «Retrage» do not ask the switch, since neither puts anybody on the list.

**Docs.** `AGENTS.md` §15.11 verb 7 and `SETUP.md` §39 item 6 say the tick follows the switch; the invitations' own release entry says it too.

**Tests.** `tests/integration/registrations/invitations.test.ts`: the send «Pe lista ascunsă» on an event whose switch is off is refused with `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`, nothing written and nobody emailed, and the same send goes through once the switch is on; the existing hidden-list invitation tests now create their event with the switch on. `tests/integration/registrations/invitation-send-action.test.ts`: the action hands back `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF` with the forecast, and both message files carry the sentence.
changelogLine: - **Invitations onto the hidden list only where it is on** — «Pe lista ascunsă» on «Trimite invitații» shows only while the event's «Folosește lista ascunsă» is ticked, and a send with it on an event whose hidden list is off is refused, nothing sent. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: A send of invitations «Pe lista ascunsă» to an event whose «Folosește lista ascunsă» is off is refused under the event lock with `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF` — the registration page's own sentence — before any invitation is written or any email queued, and the invitation form draws the tick only while the switch is on; the same send goes through once the switch is on (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: invitations go onto the hidden list only while the event's switch is on
